privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy covers Mutaba3a's apps for Mac, Windows, the browser, iPhone, and Android. They handle your data in two different ways, so we explain each one. It does not cover any other product.

scope.title: The short version
scope.body: On Mac, Windows, and in the browser, Mutaba3a keeps your business data on your own device. There's no account, and nothing you enter in the app is sent to us. The one thing our website can send us is the hosted-account request form, and only if you fill it in and press Send. The iPhone and Android apps work differently: you sign in with an account, and what you enter is saved to Mutaba3a's servers. None of our apps use analytics, ads, or tracking, and we never sell your data.

dataStorage.title: Mac, Windows, and the browser: your data stays on your device
dataStorage.body: Everything you enter — clients, projects, income, expenses, and receipts — is stored locally: in your browser's storage when you use the web app, or in a local database file when you use the Mac or Windows app. We never see it, and it never leaves your device unless you choose to export it.

mobile.title: iPhone and Android: your account and our servers
mobile.body: The mobile apps need an account, which your organization or we set up for you. There's no public sign-up. When you sign in, we keep your email address, display name, language, and which business profiles you can use. What you enter is stored on Mutaba3a's servers, and a copy is kept on your phone so the app works offline. Entries you make while offline are saved on your phone and uploaded once you're back online. Signing out ends your session on our servers. Entries that haven't uploaded yet stay on the phone and upload after you sign in again.

whatYouEnter.title: What you enter
whatYouEnter.body: You control what goes into Mutaba3a: client names and contact details, projects, income records, optional expenses, notes, and any receipts you attach. On Mac, Windows, and in the browser, none of this is sent to us. In the mobile apps, it's sent to our servers so it can be stored with your account. On iPhone, you can share a photo or PDF of a receipt into Mutaba3a. It's uploaded to private cloud storage and attached to the expense.

network.title: What reaches the network
network.body: On Mac, Windows, and in the browser, the app makes two kinds of outbound requests, and neither includes anything you've entered: it asks a public exchange-rate service (Frankfurter) for currency conversion rates, and the download page checks GitHub for the latest release version. Separately, the website's hosted-account request form sends what you type in it to Netlify when you press Send. The mobile apps connect only to Mutaba3a's servers and to the private storage that holds your receipts, always over encrypted connections.

sharing.title: Who else handles your data
sharing.body: We don't sell your data or share it with advertisers. Our servers and receipt storage run on Google Cloud, which processes the data only to host it for us. Our website runs on Netlify, which receives the hosted-account request form and checks each request for spam with Akismet (made by Automattic). If your organization has linked its business profiles to Malafat, the records in those profiles are shared between Malafat and Mutaba3a. Beyond that, we disclose data only when the law requires it.

security.title: Keeping the mobile apps secure
security.body: Your password is stored on our servers only as a secure hash, and never on your phone. Your sign-in session is kept in the iPhone Keychain or in Android's encrypted storage. You can turn on App Lock so opening the app needs Face ID, Touch ID, your fingerprint, or your device passcode. That check happens on your device, and Mutaba3a never receives your biometric data. The mobile apps don't use your camera, contacts, or location, and they only see a photo or file when you choose to share it into the app.

noTracking.title: No analytics, no ads, no tracking
noTracking.body: None of Mutaba3a's apps use analytics, advertising, crash reporting, or tracking of any kind. The Mac, Windows, and browser apps have no sign-up or login at all. Our servers keep standard technical logs (such as when a request arrived, its IP address, and whether it succeeded) so we can run the service. We don't use them to profile you.

yourControl.title: Mac, Windows, and the browser: exporting and deleting your data
yourControl.body: You can export a full backup of your data as a file at any time, and import it back in. Deleting your data is just as direct: clearing the app's storage (or uninstalling the desktop app) removes it completely, because there's no copy anywhere else.

mobileDeletion.title: Deleting your account and mobile data
mobileDeletion.body: You can delete individual entries in the mobile apps. To delete your whole account and everything stored with it, email info@malafat.app from your account's email address, and we'll do it within 30 days. Records in a business profile that belongs to your organization are your organization's, so we handle those together with them. Copies in our backups expire within 14 days of deletion. Signing out and uninstalling the app removes Mutaba3a's data from your phone.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.body: Mutaba3a is a business tool and isn't directed at children. We don't knowingly collect information from anyone under 13.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, we'll update this page and the "Last updated" date above.

hostedRequest.title: When you ask for a hosted account
hostedRequest.body: If you send the request form on our website, Netlify, which hosts the website, receives what you type: your name, your email and anything else you choose to add, plus the language the page was in and a random request number. Netlify also records technical details such as your IP address and browser, and checks the request for spam with Akismet. Netlify then emails it to us. We use it only to reply with an offer and, if you go ahead, to set up your account. We delete requests within 12 months; write to info@malafat.app and we'll delete yours sooner.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about this policy can be sent to info@malafat.app. Mutaba3a is made by Barmajiyat Ltd.
